Plot QC Metrics from MethQcSet

Source: R/MethQcSet-viz.R
plot-MethQcSet-missing-method.Rd

Generate QC-stage visualizations from stored QC tables.

Usage

# S4 method for class 'MethQcSet,missing'
plot(x, y, type = "qc_bar", icutoff = 11, pcutoff = 0.05, outFile = NULL, ...)

Arguments

x

A MethQcSet object.

y

Ignored (for generic compatibility).

type

Character scalar. One of "qc_bar" (default), "intensity", "detection_pval", "beta_density", "probe_coverage", "predicted_sex", "ctrl_metrics", "ctrl_metrics_detail".

icutoff

Numeric. log2 intensity cutoff reference line for "intensity" plot (default 11).

pcutoff

Numeric. Detection p-value cutoff reference line for "detection_pval" plot (default 0.05).

outFile

Optional file path to save the plot (format inferred from extension: pdf/png/svg).

...

Additional arguments forwarded to ggplot2::ggsave(). For type = "beta_density", supported arguments include sample_set ("all", "pass", or "fail"), group_col, max_points, and adjust.

Value

A ggplot object. Also written to outFile when provided.

Details

Plot types:

qc_bar

PASS / FAIL sample count bar chart from QC_matrix$Final.QC.

intensity

Scatter of mMed.Intensity vs uMed.Intensity per sample, colored by Final.QC, with a horizontal reference line at icutoff.

detection_pval

Per-sample average detection p-value dot plot, colored by Final.QC, with a horizontal reference line at pcutoff.

probe_coverage

Per-sample percent of probes detected (dP < 0.05), colored by Final.QC, with a reference line at 95%.

predicted_sex

Bar chart of predicted sex counts from QC_matrix$predictedSex.

beta_density

Processed beta-value density curves per sample, optionally restricted to all, PASS, or FAIL samples via sample_set. This plot is generated from the cached MethQcSet beta matrix and is complementary to raw minfi::qcReport() density output.

ctrl_metrics

Per-sample dot chart of CtrlMetrics.QC from ctrl_metrics. Returns NULL silently if ctrl_metrics is absent.

ctrl_metrics_detail

One jitter-dot plot per control-probe metric (Bisulfite Conversion, Specificity, Non-polymorphic). outFile is used as a path prefix; individual files are saved as {prefix}_ctrl_matrix_detail_{Metric}.pdf. Returns a named list of ggplot objects.

All types return NULL with a message if the required data are not yet present.
